gripOrHq.title: Snowball
gripOrHq.rulesText:
Snowball has +1 strength for each subroutine it has broken during a run, until the end of that run.
[1]: Break sentry subroutine.
[1]: +1 strength.

gripOrHq.title: Krash
gripOrHq.rulesText:
2 credits: Break ice subroutine.
2 credits: +1 strength.

gripOrHq.title: Loan from Chiba
gripOrHq.rulesText: Gain [12] when Loan from Chiba is installed. At the start of each of your turns, lose [1]. If Loan from Chiba leaves play, pay [10] or lose the game. You may trash Loan from Chiba at the end of any of your turns.

heapOrArchives.title: Temple Microcode Outlet
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Search your stack for a program. Show that program to the Corp, and then bring it into your hand. Shuffle your stack afterwards.

heapOrArchives.title: Top Runners' Conference
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Gain [2] at the start of each of your turns. Trash Top Runners' Conference when you make a run.

heapOrArchives.title: Self-Modifying Code
heapOrArchives.rulesText: [T]: Search your stack for a program and install that program, if you can. Shuffle your stack afterwards. Use this ability only during a run.

heapOrArchives.title: Private LDL Access
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Make a run on HQ. If run is successful, do not access cards from HQ; instead, treat run as a successful run on R&D.

heapOrArchives.title: Private LDL Access
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Make a run on HQ. If run is successful, do not access cards from HQ; instead, treat run as a successful run on R&D.

heapOrArchives.title: Loan from Chiba
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Gain [12] when Loan from Chiba is installed. At the start of each of your turns, lose [1]. If Loan from Chiba leaves play, pay [10] or lose the game. You may trash Loan from Chiba at the end of any of your turns.

heapOrArchives.title: Inside Job
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Make a run. You automatically pass the first piece of ice you encounter during that run.

heapOrArchives.title: R&D Interface
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Whenever you access cards from R&D, access an additional card from R&D.

scoreArea.title: Superior Net Barriers
scoreArea.rulesText: All walls have +1 strength. When you score Superior Net Barriers, reveal as many walls as you wish. Then, gain [1] for each revealed or rezzed wall.

scoreArea.title: Political Coup
scoreArea.rulesText:
Put [12] from the bank on Political Coup when you score it.
A: Take [3] from Political Coup, if it has any bits.

rig.title: Krash
rig.rulesText:
2 credits: Break ice subroutine.
2 credits: +1 strength.

rig.title: Joan of Arc
rig.rulesText:
[T]: Prevent one or more of your other installed programs from being trashed.
[1]: Prevent one or more of your other installed programs from being trashed, and bring Joan of Arc into your hand.

rig.title: R&D-Protocol Files
rig.rulesText: A: Make a run on R&D, but instead of accessing cards, look at the top five cards of R&D.

rig.title: Bartmoss Memorial Icebreaker
rig.rulesText:
[1]: Break ice subroutine.
[1]: +1 strength.
After passing each piece of ice, roll a die if you used Bartmoss Memorial Icebreaker to break any subroutines of that ice. On a 1, trash Bartmoss Memorial Icebreaker.

rig.title: R&D Interface
rig.rulesText: Whenever you access cards from R&D, access an additional card from R&D.

rig.title: Broker
rig.rulesText: Each of your turns, you may take only one action to use Broker. A: Put [3] from the bank on Broker. A: Take all the bits from Broker.

ice.title: Banpei
ice.rulesText:
[Subroutine] Trash a program.
[Subroutine] End the run.

ice.title: Laser Wire
ice.rulesText:
[Subroutine] Do 1 net damage.
[Subroutine] End the run.

ice.title: D'Arc Knight
ice.rulesText:
[Subroutine] Trash a program.
[Subroutine] End the run.

root.title: Chicago Branch
root.rulesText: A, [3]: Add two advancement counters to an installed card that can be advanced.

root.title: Encoder, Inc.
root.rulesText: Code gates cost [1] less to rez while Encoder, Inc. is rezzed. All code gates have an additional "End the run" subroutine after all other subroutines.

root.title: Omni Kismet, Ph.D.
root.rulesText: Swap a piece of unrezzed ice on this fort with an ice card stored in HQ. The new ice card comes into play concealed. Use this ability only once during each run on this fort.

root.title: Twenty-Four-Hour Surveillance
root.rulesText: During runs on this fort, Runner cannot use bits from stealth sources.

encounteredIce.title: Banpei
encounteredIce.rulesText:
[Subroutine] Trash a program.
[Subroutine] End the run.
